activity-date.narrative: KEN 3 is a platform of CSOs working on promoting SRHR in Kenya. It is made up of 19 organisation working working on different subjects targeting different groups of rights holders. Peer educators and community facilitators who will benefit directly from the project will come from these organisations. The project seeks to improve and build the capacity of KEN 3 partners and other RFSU partners on delivery and inclusion of sex-positive and pleasure-based CSE thus building a movement of Civil Society Organizations able to speak up and advocate for the inclusion of Age-Appropriate Comprehensive Sexuality education that is sex-positive and wholistic including pleasure. Results for Oct 2025 - 2028: - Empowered CSE facilitators who approach the delivery of CSE through the principles of sex positive and pleasure-based comprehensive sexuality education. - Improved overall messaging and language around controversial SRHR issues, away from threat and danger to respect and enjoyment of sexual rights. - Existing public support on SRHR issues through pleasure-based messages that also fit the context of the community on SRHR. - Coordinated KEN 3 partners who maintain a similar voice when it comes to pleasure-based and sex positive CSE, using research-based evidence to influence policies at the National level on the delivery of CSE. - Aligned policy advocacy efforts on CSE at the national and regional level.
